def factor_cycle_range_pressure_full60(df):
    """Buyer/seller pressure within trailing 60-day range; partial windows allowed to control NaN fraction."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    buy_pressure = (df_copy["close"] - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    sell_pressure = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["close"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    total_range = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    df_copy["factor_cycle_range_pressure_full60"] = (buy_pressure - sell_pressure) / total_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_cycle_range_pressure_full60"]
description: Preserves the parent's core accumulation/distribution mechanism: within a stock's own trailing 60-day high-low range, buy-side pressure and sell-side pressure are accumulated and their net difference normalized by total range. The min_periods is reduced from 60 to 20 to satisfy the NaN fraction guard; this retains most of the desired window stability while allowing earlier estimates only after 20 observations. The raw single-stock signal remains continuous and is returned without cross-sectional ranking, preserving the parent's payoff evidence.
